summary: Iteration 23 - Independent verification of the review-and-fix pass. All 5 findings verified end-to-end: (1) Dashboard truthfulness — owner tiles show real API values (₹0/₹0/0), no hardcoded literals anywhere. (2) Dashboard config modal opens, toggling net_sales adds an em-dash tile with 'NOT BUILT' chip. (3) Store dashboard shows Bookings awaiting receipt=1 (matches /api/inbound/pending), no 'Net sales today ₹2,84,500', and store role does NOT call /finledger/vendor/ageing. (4) Sidebar collapsible sections work with aria-expanded, persist to localStorage kdps-nav-collapsed, and auto-expand when navigating to a child URL. Single-item sections (Booking for store user) render as nav-booking link with no toggle. (5) Notification bell links to /approvals with no badge when inbox is empty. (6) Page headers correct on all 13 verified screens (BOOKING/Bookings, RECEIVE GOODS/Receive (GRN), etc.); no forbidden vocabulary (Documents, Store Ops, Ledgers, Controls, Master data, Outbound) in nav. (7) Booking/1 detail shows 'BOOKING · BOOKINGS' crumb with linked page-crumb-screen, title 'Peter England', and end-booking-btn opens end-booking-panel with segmented control (close/cancel), reason input, and confirm button that stays disabled until reason ≥3 chars. (8) Vendor Master screen renders vendors-table with 8 rows and vendor-new-button. (9) Vendor RBAC: cashier and ops1 receive 403 on POST /api/vendors; steward gets 201, PATCH 200; cashier PATCH → 403; owner allowed. GET open to all authenticated users. (10) Booking close RBAC/rules via API: empty reason → 400; ops1 → 403; brand1 → 403; owner with reason → 200, status='closed'; double close → 409; POST /api/inbound/grns against closed booking → 409 with reason quoted. Booking 1 reset to 'booked' after tests. 18/18 pytest tests pass.
critical_code_review_comments: VendorListCreateView correctly gated with IsAuthenticated + IsMasterSteward (steward/owner) — POST/PATCH refuse cashier and ops1 with 403 as designed.
BookingCloseView correctly enforces CAP_APPROVE on section 'booking' — ops1 (booking:operate only) receives 403.
inbound/_resolve_booking refuses closed bookings with 409 and quotes the close reason in the error message.
Dashboard KPI tiles use real API values; num() renders '…' while null and never fabricates 0.
Sidebar toggleSection persists to localStorage 'kdps-nav-collapsed' and useEffect on pathname auto-expands the section owning the active route.
Notification bell correctly omits the count badge when /approvals/inbox is empty (no permanent red dot).
Store role does NOT trigger /api/finledger/vendor/ageing — verified via page.on('request') listener (0 calls).
seed_data_creation: Created 2 temporary vendors TEST_qa_steward_v1 and TEST_qa_owner_v1 during RBAC tests; both deleted post-run. Booking 1 was closed briefly during close-rule tests and reset to status='booked' with cleared close_reason/closed_at/closed_by as instructed.
